regions.region: page 1 title, authors, metadata, and abstract
regions.finding: Verified the article title and the aggregate asymmetric Grignard-addition/propargyl-Claisen cascade claim. The abstract is an article-level summary, not an additional experiment.

Inspected the displayed generic 2-O-propargyl enone/RbMgX/PMP-H8-BINOL transformation (3.9 equiv Grignard, 1.4 equiv ligand, DCM 0.05 M, -90 °C to room temperature, >20:1 dr, up to 98:2 er). It is linked to the current generic map and concrete Table 1/Scheme 3 rows, not counted as another experiment.

regions.region: page 1 introduction and cited prior-work prose
regions.finding: Classified generic Claisen/propargyl-Claisen chemistry and the Feng, Xie/Guo, and Ley transformations as prior/context records rather than current-paper experiments.

Linked the DCM/-78 °C/82% pilot result to the single Scheme 2 pilot/scope-entry-1 record. The sequential low-temperature addition and warming-to-room-temperature stages are preserved with missing times.

unresolved: The graphical abstract has generic R groups and no experiment-specific time or workup.
The pilot procedure omits addition/hold/warming durations and operational workup details.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Visually separated two generic background arrows, two asymmetric cited examples, one Ley cited total-synthesis example, the current generic cascade, and proposed chelate 7. No cited or proposed item was promoted to a current experiment.
Recorded four independent solvent/temperature rows. The DCM/-78 °C row is the same 82% experiment as scope entry 1 and page-1 prose, so its evidence is merged rather than duplicated.

regions.region: page 2 Scheme 2 scope table entries 1-20 and footnotes a-e
regions.finding: Recorded every distinct scope row with R/Ra/Rb labels, 1.3 equiv Grignard except entry 12 at 1.1 equiv, entry-5 0 °C addition, reflux rows 5/8/15/19, yields, >20:1 crude-NMR dr where a desired allene formed, and entry-19 1,2-addition-only outcome.
Mapped prose substrate trends and the 3.9 equiv Grignard/1.4 equiv ligand asymmetric pilot description to the existing Scheme 2 and Table 1 records without creating narrative duplicates.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits stage times, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and yield basis.
The 0% 6s row gives no amount/yield for its 1,2-addition product, and the shared dr footnote is not assigned to that unspecified product.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left Table 1 entries 1-13, ligand key, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all thirteen ligand/solvent/temperature experiments independently. Shared 3.9 equiv MeMgBr, 1.4 equiv ligand, 0.05 M solvent, low-temperature addition then warming to room temperature, unquantified volatile-product yield, er, >20:1 dr, and analytical bases are retained row-wise.

regions.region: page 3 right-column Scheme 3 products 6a-6t and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded seventeen displayed asymmetric scope rows with yields, er, >20:1 dr for formed allenes, reflux footnotes, 6s 0%/1,2-addition-only result, and the displayed X-ray characterization linkage.

regions.region: page 3 two-column optimization and scope prose
regions.finding: Mapped ligand trends and the optimized -90 °C PMP-H8-BINOL condition to Table 1/Scheme 3 rows. Table 1 yields remain unquantified and were not replaced by later Scheme 3 yields.

unresolved: Table 1 and Scheme 3 omit stage times, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and most yield bases.
Complex structures remain source-labeled where safe stereochemical SMILES encoding was uncertain.
Footnote-11 failures are stated on page 6 and use the explicitly named asymmetric/racemic standard condition families as cross-page evidence.

regions.region: page 4 upper-left continuation of Scheme 3 discussion
regions.finding: Linked scope trends and X-ray-based stereochemical assignment for (+)-6g/(+)-6j/(+)-6l to the existing Scheme 3 records. No prose duplicate was created.
Recorded 2.6 equiv and 1.1 equiv MeMgBr reactions of (+)-8 as distinct experiments, including -78 °C-to-reflux staging, 66%/40% yields, >20:1 dr, and the different C3/C17 addition outcomes.

Recorded separate one-gram racemic and asymmetric 5j runs. The asymmetric record retains 93% product yield, 94:6 er, >20:1 dr, and 91% pure-ligand mass recovery; recovery is not treated as product yield.

Recorded racemic and enantioenriched two-step 6j->10->11 sequences separately, preserving the 87%/86% yields as overall two-step yields. Recorded the two independent RuCl3/NaIO4 oxidations to 12 with 70%/71% outcomes.
Recorded asymmetric and racemic reactions of 13 independently with all displayed Grignard/ligand/concentration/temperature, yield, dr, and er facts.

regions.region: page 4 conclusions and Associated Content statement
regions.finding: The conclusion adds no new experiment. The online Supporting Information statement does not establish workspace SI association and no SI-only procedure was imported.

unresolved: Scheme 4 omits most absolute scales, reaction times, atmospheres, workups, purifications, masses, and measurement bases.
The 6j->11 yields are overall two-step yields; individual reduction and cyclization yields remain missing.

regions.region: page 5 upper-left Supporting Information and accession-code statements

regions.finding: Bibliography/prior-literature citations only. These references were not promoted to current-paper experiments.
